WITH patient_lab AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    l.WBC,
    l.HGB,
    l.HCT,
    CASE WHEN l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL 
         THEN l.HGB / l.HCT 
         ELSE NULL 
    END AS ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  INNER JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
),
patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    SEX,
    AVG(WBC) AS avg_wbc,
    AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM patient_lab
  GROUP BY ID, SEX
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
  WHERE avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  ps.ID,
  ps.SEX,
  ps.avg_wbc,
  ps.avg_ratio,
  ps.avg_ratio - om.mean_ratio AS diff
FROM patient_stats ps
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE ps.avg_ratio > om.mean_ratio
ORDER BY 
  diff IS NULL,
  diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The database uses LIMIT syntax for row limiting (MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite conventions; SQL Server would require TOP 10)
